title: The Vine Gatherers
logline: Cane cutters walk into the scrub, take hold of a vine wherever they first find it, root, middle or tip, and pull its whole hidden length out of the undergrowth to be split and woven into baskets that no single length of vine could have made alone.

object.note: Object 9 (identity not chosen) may appear subtly, for example among Chathura's things while he travels, waits or watches, only where it sits naturally in a real moment. Never staged, never the subject.

thread_in.thread: A chain followed forward becomes a chain that can be entered anywhere: cane cutters pulling a vine's hidden length from wherever they first grasp it.

thread_out.thread: Split vine woven into something no single length could make leads to bamboo poles leaning on each other's tips until, together, the frame holds.

lesson.in_simple_terms: You can grab a long vine wherever you first find it and still pull the whole thing out. The texts say the chain of a life can be explained starting from any point, because no first beginning can be found.
lesson.in_simple_terms_si: දිගු වැලක් මුලින්, මැදින් හෝ අගින් අල්ලාගෙන මුළුමනින්ම ඇදගත හැකි සේ, පළමු ආරම්භයක් සොයාගත නොහැකි සසර දාමය ද ඕනෑම තැනකින් පටන්ගෙන පැහැදිලි කළ හැකිය.
lesson.the_teaching: The Pradeepika says the Buddha taught dependent origination in four ways: beginning to end, middle to end, end to beginning, and middle to beginning, like four men pulling in a vine from wherever they first see it, root, middle or tip. Starting the formula with ignorance does not mark a first cause: both books say the round has no first beginning, and Margaya says the teaching shows how the round keeps going, not how the world began. Within any telling, the formula keeps its fixed order, each clause handing on to the next.
lesson.how_the_film_shows_it: The gatherers walk into the scrub and cut wherever the hand first meets the vine, then haul out a hidden length far longer than it looked. Split and woven, the vine becomes a basket in which every strand has to hold its place, so the viewer sees both ideas: a way in from anywhere, and an order that must be kept.

key_terms.en: teaching in forward order / in reverse order

lesson.caution: It does not mean ignorance is where the world began: both books deny any first beginning, and the vine is the texts' picture of a way of teaching, not a claim about where things start.
lesson.builds_on: The last film followed a chain forward from its start; this one shows the texts' point that the chain can be entered anywhere, because no first link can be found.
lesson.evidence_class: editorial interpretation grounded in cited source teaching
